facts.business: Lorenzini Apparels Limited is engaged in the apparel business with all manufacturing and production activities outsourced to third-party manufacturers.
facts.related_party_note: The Company entered into 2 material related party transactions at arm's length basis with Mr. Button Private Limited (where Mr. Sandeep Jain is Director and Member) for Sale and Purchase for a period of 5 financial years commencing from FY 2024-25. All transactions with related parties were on arm's length basis and in compliance with Section 188 of the Act.
